notes.title: Demo update with visual improvements and new features
notes.content:
The new demo update for Mangut is live! :) 

We redesigned the first stage to improve visual clarity and consistency 

A visual effect was added to the bullet time mechanic 

The demo now includes a save system so you can resume where you left off 

We made significant tuning to the grappling hook and aiming system 

Multiple bugs were fixed for a smoother experience
